## Category Page Audit (Politics, Entertainment, Economics, Weather)

Starting the comprehensive Category Page Audit for bainluck.com. I'll be auditing the Politics, Entertainment, Economics, and Weather pages across all dimensions: data freshness, cross-source matching, classification accuracy, data quality, visual design, and upstream coverage. This will involve visiting multiple sites and taking screenshots.

I have completed the deep audit of the four category pages on bainluck.com (Politics, Entertainment, Economics, and Weather). 

I've evaluated data freshness, cross-source matching, classification accuracy, visual design, and data quality across all pages, and cross-referenced with Kalshi and Polymarket to identify coverage gaps.

The most critical findings include:
1. A monotonicity data error on the Entertainment page for Rotten Tomatoes scores.
2. Rendering failures on the Weather page where the temperature map and precipitation sections are stuck in a loading state.
3. Several political markets misclassified into the Entertainment section.
4. Past-dated markets still appearing across multiple categories.
